STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: mg_09105_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: mg_09105_combined.v · Open raw
module mg_09105(input [0:3]cru_base,input ti_cru_clk,input ti_memen,input ti_ph3,input [0:14]addr,input ti_cru_out,output ti_cru_in,output [0:3]bits);
reg [0:3] bits_q; 
 always @(negedge ti_cru_clk) begin 
  if ((addr[0:3] == 4'b0001) && (addr[4:7] == cru_base)) begin 
  if (addr[8:14] == 7'h00) bits_q[0] <= ti_cru_out; 
  else if (addr[8:14] == 7'h01) bits_q[1] <= ti_cru_out; 
  else if (addr[8:14] == 7'h02) bits_q[2] <= ti_cru_out; 
  else if (addr[8:14] == 7'h03) bits_q[3] <= ti_cru_out; 
  end 
 end 
 assign bits = bits_q; 
 reg dataout; 
 always @(negedge ti_ph3) begin 
  if (ti_memen && (addr[0:3] == 4'b0001) && (addr[4:7] == cru_base)) begin 
  if (addr[8:14] == 7'h00) dataout <= bits_q[0]; 
  else if (addr[8:14] == 7'h01) dataout <= bits_q[1]; 
  else if (addr[8:14] == 7'h02) dataout <= bits_q[2]; 
  else if (addr[8:14] == 7'h03) dataout <= bits_q[3]; 
  end 
  else dataout <= 1'bz; 
 end 
 assign ti_cru_in = dataout; 
 endmodule

Generate the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name mg_09105.

Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.
